_readme: Parking ramps OpenStreetMap doesn't carry, curated by hand.
The extractor takes a building only when OSM gives it a name (way[building][name]),
and 27 of the 50 parking structures inside the downtown bbox are unnamed. Ramps are
the worst-served category in OSM downtown: mappers trace the parcel and move on, so
the thing a driver knows the name of is exactly the thing the dataset lacks.
Applied to public/data/skymap-data.json by scripts/apply-parking-overlay.mjs. Run it
after every `npm run data:osm`, alongside the POI and hours overlays — extraction
rewrites the dataset and would otherwise drop all of this.
Two independent sources per entry, same rule as poi-overlay.json, and the operator
wins on conflict. For a municipal ramp that means the city's own directory and the
management company's facility page.
`footprint` is optional and usually empty. A ramp OSM hasn't mapped has no traced
outline anywhere public, and drawing a plausible rectangle around the address would
be inventing survey data. An entry with no footprint is a located building rather
than an outlined one: distanceToFootprint already falls back to the centroid, so it
routes and it answers 'am I parked here' — a little less precisely, which is the
truth about what we know. Fill footprint in only from a cited traced source.
`connectsTo` names the buildings the ramp reaches by skyway. It needs its own two
sources — a ramp that claims a bridge it doesn't have would route someone into a
wall — and it carries no geometry, so the route line falls back to centroids for
that leg, which routeCoords already does for any edge OSM hasn't traced.
When OSM catches up with an entry, the script reports it as retirable rather than
emitting a second ramp on the same corner. Retire it then — upstream is the better
record, and it will carry an outline this file can't.

hennepin-at-10th-x.name: Hennepin at 10th
hennepin-at-10th-x.note: The report that started this file: 'I can never seem to get the Hennepin @ 10th ramp to show up.' 880 spaces, municipal, skyway-connected, and absent from OSM entirely — no building, no amenity=parking, and no Hennepin County parcel under its address either. The city directory and the operator agree on the name and on 935 Hennepin Avenue; the operator adds that it is the southeast corner of Hennepin and S 10th St, vehicles in from 9th and out onto 10th. The two multi-storey ramps OSM does map within 250m are both unnamed and neither is this one.
